name: razor-compile-no-imports-no-tag-helpers
body: Compile processes one Razor file with no import sources (_ViewImports.cshtml/_Imports.razor) and no tag helpers, so namespaces and usings brought in by import files are absent from the generated tree; Razor warnings pass silently and only errors throw. Upgrade: phase 7's CollectImports and declaration-only pass supply imports and component binding.
